decision: Preserve the invalid result and permit one root-cause successor that adds RegionKind to the V2 checkpoint serializer allowlist and proves region-bearing restart in a focused regression test.

results.profile_binding_preflight: first invocation rejected the default historical profile before journey execution; the exact final profile was then supplied explicitly
results.qualification_interpretation: invalid because the application log rejected a region-bearing LangGraph checkpoint during governed restoration

root_cause: The governed T1-v2 JsonPlusSerializer allowlist included SourceCitation and DocumentChunk-related result models but omitted src.digital_twin.grounding.models.RegionKind. Live PDF ingestion populated RegionKind.TEXT, so restart deserialization failed even though the HTTP request failed closed with status 200.
why_existing_tests_missed_it: The restart fixture carried citations with region_kind=null and therefore never exercised enum deserialization.
permitted_correction: Add only RegionKind to the checkpoint serializer allowlist and extend the existing interrupt/restart regression to persist and restore a RegionKind.TEXT citation. Rebuild immutable images and rerun the full exact qualification on a fresh project.
